candidate_workaround: Complete the append-only fail/pass witness transition and preferred-state update before invoking assertions that require a balanced ledger.
failure_signature: A validation assertion sees one more failed witness than passing witness because recovery evidence was not finalized first.
recurrence_guard: Never run a balanced-witness terminal assertion while a known recovery still lacks its passing witness and state transition.
rollback: No external or sibling state changed; restore only the uncommitted owner-local ledger from its preceding valid JSON if a transition fails.
scope_boundary: Eiren v648-v3 validation-order evidence only; no scientific, identity, authority, production, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Finalize Method Flow recovery before balanced-witness validation
trigger_preconditions: A known recovery has a retained failing witness but its passing witness or preferred-state transition is still pending.
